task_prompt: Steady the banana and slice it with the kitchen knife.
task_summary: The left hand steadies a banana segment on the counter while the right hand repeatedly slices it with a kitchen knife.

objects.name: yellow banana segment
properties: Food segment can be separated into slices by a sharp blade.
The left hand stabilizes the segment during the cuts.
Successful slicing requires new separate pieces, not just a blade pose.
objects.evidence: Banana is steadied at 1.5-3 s and cut repeatedly near 3-17.5 s.

objects.name: kitchen knife
properties: Long rigid blade and handle move together.
The blade edge is lowered repeatedly through the banana.
The cutting contact must cause material separation.
objects.evidence: Right hand holds the knife throughout 0-17.5 s.

subgoals.action: Hold the knife above the counter.
subgoals.goal: The knife is held in the right hand.
The banana is held in the left hand.

hand_roles.left: Stabilizes the banana on the counter.

subgoals.goal: The banana is cut into separate slices.

hand_roles.right: Lowers and raises the blade repeatedly.

task_success: The banana is cut into separate slices, the knife is held in the right hand.
